metadata.description: Curated AI agent skills for software development — game dev, pixel art, image generation, and more.

plugins.name: phaser-gamedev
plugins.description: Build 2D browser games with Phaser 3 — scenes, sprites, Arcade/Matter physics, tilemaps, animations, keyboard input.

plugins.name: image-generation
plugins.description: Generate game assets via Google Gemini API and process them into final sprite files.

plugins.name: pixellab
plugins.description: Generate pixel art assets using PixelLab MCP — Wang tilesets, characters, map objects.

plugins.name: pixellab-api
plugins.description: PixelLab API v2 direct access — animate sprites, generate UI elements, edit pixel art, rotate/resize, style matching.

plugins.name: mac-maintenance
plugins.description: Safe, scan-first macOS maintenance — inventory disk/updates/caches read-only, report reclaimable space, then clean/upgrade only what the user approves.

plugins.name: graylog-search
plugins.description: Search any Graylog instance via its REST API — token auth, universal search endpoints, Lucene DSL, stream scoping, level/timezone pitfalls, and findings published as a shareable HTML report artifact.

plugins.name: product-hunt-launch
plugins.description: Fill a Product Hunt launch form end-to-end via the chrome-devtools MCP — name, tagline, description, tags, thumbnail, gallery upload — then stop before publishing.

plugins.name: mysql-schema-design
plugins.description: Design MySQL 8 schemas that enforce data integrity — naming, NOT NULL/DEFAULT semantics, datetime vs timestamp, DECIMAL for money, FK ON DELETE rules, CHECK constraints, collations, index hygiene.

plugins.name: html-slide-deck
plugins.description: Build self-contained HTML slide decks — one file, 1920×1080 auto-scaling stage, keyboard navigation, dark/light themes, speaker notes as HTML comments, token-based design system with a runnable template.
